label: FP
reason: User input from cookies is decoded via ESAPI (safe) then passed to MessageDigest hashing which produces a fixed-length hex/Base64 digest. The original unencoded input is never written directly to HTML output; only the encoded hash is printed. Thus XSS is mitigated.

evidence.note: cookie value decoded and used as input to MessageDigest
only encoded hash written to response, not original input
